title: psychotria ligustrina
intro: Psychotria ligustrina, commonly known as Wild Forest, is a species of flowering plant in the family Rubiaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly in treating various health conditions due to its numerous health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties.
